projects.name: Helios Data Center Campus
projects.quote: The Helios Data Center Campus is Galaxy’s flagship facility that, at 1.6GW of approved grid capacity, is projected to be the largest known 100% front-of-the-meter data center campus.

projects.name: Helios Phase I
projects.quote: Galaxy delivered the first data hall to CoreWeave and remains on budget and on schedule to deliver substantially all 133 megawatts of critical IT load under the Phase I lease agreement by the end of Q2 2026.

projects.name: Helios Phase II
projects.quote: Greenfield development for the 260 megawatt Phase II build is underway, with civil and structural work advancing .

projects.name: Helios CoreWeave Leases (Phases I+II+III)
projects.quote: CoreWeave has leased 526 MW of critical IT capacity for a period of 15 years, generating anticipated average annual revenue of over $1B for the combined three phases.

projects.name: Helios additional 830 MW ERCOT power capacity
projects.quote: On January 15, 2026 Galaxy announced the completion of ERCOT Interconnection Studies and the approval for additional 830 MW at Helios.
